protocol.training: Two fixed epochs, batch4, Adam1e-4, all18 trainable variables through the inference graph; batch-normalization statistics fixed; note BCE only, no artificial onset or contour targets.
protocol.data: All555 takes retained with their original intended labels: pass1 train200, pass2 calibration200, pass3 test155; all roles anchor every take before random mixtures. Source-disjoint intervals, same instrument/session; previously inspected evidence, not a new blind test.
protocol.windows: Offline Kaiser5 resample147/640 of each complete take, then fixed uniform crop or zero placement, 110-sample edge taper, RMS normalization and fixed gain grid. No time stretch, pitch shift, exclusion, relabeling or repeated short takes. Nominal frame centers256*i carry the original pitch within the retained crop, including taper.
protocol.onsets: Original captures start within sustain, so no onset labels are invented. Shared-weight onset changes are measured with the unchanged causal decoder.
protocol.final_model: Epoch2 only; no selection using calibration/test.
protocol.representation: Train precision>=99%, calibration and test>=95%; recall>=80%, exact_set>=70% overall and separately for3/4/5 distinct pitches, silence extras0. Distinct pitch frames, not installed note/string matching.
protocol.source_preservation: Every source occurrence must preserve present frames and longest correct run against unmodified TensorFlow, with all per-occurrence deltas retained.
protocol.continuous: Always score ordinary and extended-middle after a completed fit, even if a representation gate fails; both unchanged TensorFlow and adapted TensorFlow use the same causal streaming code, raw recording amplitude (no additional input trim), one CPU thread, and all88 output pitches.
protocol.continuous_primary: Measured FIFO worker completion including model, buffer/resample and decoder; source availability is diagnostic only. Sequential paired measurement includes machine timing noise.
protocol.research_acceptance: All representation/source gates, plus every existing per-label hold/presence, wrong/gap, exact-set/all-expected nonregression clause against both unmodified TensorFlow and saved CURRENT on both recordings; ordinary gain>=5pp against CURRENT. Does not promote.
protocol.backend: TensorFlow versus ONNX parity failed the prior synthetic probe. The unchanged TensorFlow model is the adaptation control; backend differences cannot be reported as adaptation gains.
protocol.limitations: Ordinary reuses source takes and is descriptive, not independent generalization. No strings, equal-pitch unison multiplicity, bend/repluck, native allocation/deadline or DAW/device claim.
protocol.resource: Existing GitHub CPU route only, no local model/audio execution,105-minute process limit120-minute job, one thread, epochs saved atomically, bulk evidence remote.
